entities.summary: Shanghai–Wuhan–Chengdu passenger-dedicated line or Huhanrong PDL, is a fully completed rail corridor in China. It is operated by CR Shanghai Group, CR Wuhan Group and CR Chengdu Group. The Chinese name of the railway line, Huhanrong, is a combination of the abbreviations for Shanghai, Wuhan, and Chengdu, three major cities along the line. Shanghai–Wuhan–Chengdu High-Speed Railway is a railway line from Asia. Classified as Tier D (Quantitative) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
